epic.title: P0 · Psyche Research: deliver an operable, bounded practitioner archive pilot
epic.body:
## Outcome and current evidence

Build an accessible research archive for independent AI builders, practitioners, and researchers with open eligibility, bounded founder capacity, private intake, human moderation, and stable versioned publication. This is a delivery epic, not authorization to launch, deploy, pay, accept terms, create persistent credentials, approve PRs, or contact participants.

On 2026-11-04 the repository contained only README.md at 6f6914b8aebf42075947731c6f7a57b4ba34fd91. Remote checks found one unprotected main branch, no issues or PRs, no rulesets, and zero workflow runs. Authenticated BunsDev has admin/push access. CLI DNS and credentials are unavailable; the GitHub connector supplies repository reads and authorized planning writes. Deployment history endpoint is unavailable through that connector, so deployment history is unverified. No prior archive charter is available; assumptions must be recorded.

## Milestones and dependencies

M0: decisions and foundation. M1: private-to-public archive. M2: pilot operations and acceptance. M3: optional human review and isolated reputation research. Implementation links and the acyclic dependency graph will be filled after issue creation; all delivery work remains unchecked until its acceptance evidence exists.

The critical path is governance → foundation → identity/intake → moderation → publication → operations → pilot decision. Policy research and threat-model/test design can run independently; shared migrations and publication edits are serialized.

## Scope and exclusions

Use a curated overlay with author-hosted artifacts and a Django modular monolith with a relational database. Single-host SQLite is the reversible local/pilot default, subject to restore and deployment acceptance. No routine code execution, remote content fetching, file uploads, automatic publication, paid admission, reputation ranking, fabricated research, or implied reviewer board. Review/vouch features are a later milestone and must not be advertised as available.

## Observable acceptance

- [ ] Every child issue has verified links, explicit dependencies, acceptance criteria, security/privacy notes, tests, evidence, rollback, priority/effort, and self-contained goal/resumption prompts.
- [ ] A contributor can create, save, resume and submit bounded private work; another user cannot read or mutate it.
- [ ] A human moderator can request changes, decline, publish an exact submitted version, pause intake, and record appeal/decision history; self-approval is prevented.
- [ ] Stable public versions support discovery/search, corrections, version history and withdrawal tombstones without private-data leakage.
- [ ] Operational tests cover privacy, permissions, retries, limits, migrations, backup restoration, and the absence of reputation influence.
- [ ] Accessible rendered client evidence, independent agent code review, founder runbook, policy drafts, onboarding and a bounded pilot go/no-go packet exist.
- [ ] Deployment, legal/policy acceptance, human accessibility acceptance, operational ownership and pilot activation are separately verified or explicitly blocked.

## Implementation, security and verification

Read docs/STATUS.md and linked decisions before every cycle. Work in reviewable slices, record exact commands/results and first failures, obtain independent review of sensitive paths, keep manuscript text out of public issues/logs, and update the graph/checklist as evidence advances. Synthetic fixtures belong only in tests and isolated demonstrations. Moderation is not scientific validation; review/vouch endorsements must bind to an immutable version and scope.

## Recovery, priority and effort

P0; several focused implementation cycles plus human operating acceptance. Keep intake paused by default. Roll back application releases only with compatible schema and a verified snapshot; preserve published identities and tombstones. Do not close existing or delivery issues merely because code exists. The authoritative resumption record is docs/STATUS.md.

## Long-running goal

Deliver the full Psyche Research pilot in OpenCoven/psyche-research by following this epic and its linked acceptance gates, implementing the highest-value unblocked issue, running actual tests, independently reviewing sensitive changes, maintaining evidence, and stopping dependent work only at a specific required approval or external blocker.

## Resume

Read repository instructions, this epic, current child issues, docs/STATUS.md, decisions, git state and outstanding checks. Verify prior claims against current files and remote state, preserve existing ownership, pick the critical-path unblocked item, implement and verify it, and update evidence without claiming deployment or human acceptance from local tests.
